acq_time.Description: Acquisition time of the particular scan

duration.Description: Wallclock duration of the scan, in seconds, from the onset of the first to the end of the last stored volume or sample, as established by HeuDiConv. What it includes depends on duration_source. See also https://github.com/bids-standard/bids-specification/pull/2508

duration_source.Description: What HeuDiConv established duration from, which determines what it includes

Levels.volume-onsets: From the onset of the first stored volume to the end of the last one, per the acquisition times of the volumes as numbered in the DICOMs. Does not include what precedes the first stored volume
Levels.ge-tag: GE's private Acquisition Duration (0019,105A) of the DICOMs. Includes preparation and dummy scans
Levels.ge-tag-scaled: As ge-tag, scaled to the share of the planned volumes which is stored
Levels.dicom-tag: AcquisitionDuration (0018,9073) of the DICOMs. Includes preparation, reference and dummy scans, and is of what was planned should the scan have been aborted
Levels.siemens-protocol: Scan time which the Siemens protocol of a single volume declares (lTotalScanTimeSec), in whole seconds
Levels.tr-x-volumes: RepetitionTime times the number of volumes of the NIfTI, there being no DICOMs to tell
Levels.sidecar-tag: AcquisitionDuration of the JSON sidecar of a single volume, as the converter recorded it, there being no DICOMs to tell
